newsitem.title: GERMANY: German economy probably grew in 1st qtr - Rexrodt.
newsitem.headline: German economy probably grew in 1st qtr - Rexrodt.

text.p: The German economy probably grew in the first quarter, but there is no improvement on the labour market and growth must accelerate to meet Bonn's forecasts for the full year, Economics Minister Guenter Rexrodt said on Wednesday.

Speaking at a news conference in Bonn on the economic outlook for the German building sector, Rexrodt said the economy had picked up again but that the pace of expansion must speed up if growth of 2.5 percent is to be reached for the year.
"The conditions for this, however, are good," he said.
Rexrodt added that the situation on the German labour market had not improved. Despite mild weather in March, employment levels had not offset job losses at the beginning of the year.
He said he expected the labour market to improve slightly this year, but that on average unemployment would be higher.
